sections.appearance: Mashiro has black bob cut hair with bangs, black shiny eyes and a pair of black angel wings on the back. Halo ==== Mashiro's halo is formed by two red circles, with the outer circle having and two blunts below. Uniform ==== Mashiro wears a standard uniform, wearing a black sailor shirt with a red stripe on her sleeves and her short pleated skirt unusually high on the waist, a red armband with "Justice" written on it, a red ribbon, and a choker on her neck. Her hands are covered with black armed gloves, and her feet with black socks and black boots with red soles. Gym: She was wearing a white athletic t-shirt with black trim on the collar and cuffs, and the Trinity logo on the left chest. She wore black athletic shorts with a white stripe down the sides. She wore black athletic shoes with white soles. Firearm ==== thumb|Manifestation of Justice|150px She uses a red wood pattern Anzio Ironworks 20mm anti-materiel rifle with a black barrel shroud and barrel. Her club's logo is stamped on the stock.
